pages.text: Modifiers are deep-cut gestures layered onto a finished symbol. Each modifier claims a small, fixed set of cells derived from the symbol's own shape — so the same gesture works on every pattern.$(br2)Compatible modifiers may be stacked, but every deep cell must belong to a complete modifier: stray deep cuts spoil the work.

Modifiers are meant to be $(bold)discovered$(). The table quietly names each one the moment you've formed it correctly, and tints its cells — experiment with symmetric gestures and watch the status line.$(br2)Each modifier also lengthens a bangle's cooldown, so power has a price.
